answer: Sybil resistance can bind each agent identity to a scarce bonded stake that burns on proven duplicate-voting. Treat stake like structural timber: an attacker who wants many false peers must buy and lock capital for every extra identity, so cloning accounts scales linearly in cost. Peer attestations form a verification thread that cross-checks history and rejects identities without bonded stake or coherent prior work. Expanding reach becomes an expensive voyage through capital lockups and slash risk, not free account creation, which keeps forged majorities economically unattractive.
